newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank dominates Estonia share trade.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank dominates Estonia share trade.

text.p: Shares in leading commercial bank Hansapank dominated turnover on the Estonian stock exchange on Wednesday, dealers said.
Overall market turnover on the official list was 15 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index fell by 0.40 percent to 109.22.
Hansapank dipped slightly to 107.85 kroons from 108 kroons on trade of seven million kroons.
The Tallinn Pharmaceutical plant was also active on the main list, turning over 4.5 million kroons and closing lower at 56 kroons versus 56.75 kroons.

On the secondary over-the-counter market trade came to 3.9 million kroons and the Norma plastics factory was the most active on turnover of 1.7 million kroons. It ended at 27 kroons after 26.55 kroons yesterday.
